name: Kinomoto Sakuya
source: The second daughter of the family, [url=/c9816]Misaki's[/url] older twin sister and [url=/c83454]Kyouichi's[/url] classmate. She has always liked Kyouichi, but can't confess her feelings to him. However, everyone else aside from the ever-dense Kyouichi is aware of her feelings.
